glossary.definition: The lab runs one pingcli version (1.2.0). Commands and output shapes change between versions, so automation pins the version it was written against.
A pingcli configuration profile that authenticates as a PingOne worker application with a client id and secret. pingcli pingone auth login turns it into a stored access token.
A cURL-like command that calls the PingOne management API with the profile's token and prints the JSON response, with lists under data._embedded.
Instruction packs a coding agent can install so it uses Ping CLI correctly. The lab installs one only into a throwaway folder.

stories.title: Check the tool
stories.say: Before Jordan Ellis automates anything, they check which Ping CLI build is installed: the version pins what the commands and output shapes look like.

stories.title: What can be configured
stories.say: Every setting pingcli reads has a key. The worker client id, secret, environment id and root domain are the four that matter for Northwind Storefront.

stories.title: Where am I
stories.say: With a token, Jordan Ellis lists the environments the worker can see, and finds Northwind Storefront and its sandbox.

stories.title: Who is in the directory
stories.say: The users of Northwind Retail come back as JSON a script can filter: name, username, email, enabled.

stories.title: What apps exist
stories.say: The applications registered for Northwind Retail: web, mobile, single-page and the worker this lab itself uses.

stories.title: How people sign in
stories.say: Sign-on policies decide how Northwind Retail users authenticate; the default is the one most people hit.

stories.title: Who can do what
stories.say: The built-in roles are not environment-scoped, so this is the one command whose URI has no environment id.

stories.title: Hand it to an agent
stories.say: Ping CLI ships agent skills: instructions a coding agent can load so it drives pingcli for Jordan Ellis correctly.
